request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

messages.content:
Rule BR-CBACT04C-005: Interest transaction record written for each interest-bearing category balance

### given[0]: The monthly interest for a category balance has just been calculated.
fields=['WS-MONTHLY-INT'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   460            EXIT.
   461       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   462        1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST.
   463 
>> 464            COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-INT
>> 465             = ( TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200
>> 466 
>> 467            ADD WS-MONTHLY-INT  TO WS-TOTAL-INT
>> 468            PERFORM 1300-B-WRITE-TX.
   469 
   470            EXIT.
   471 
   472       *---------------------------------------------------------------*

### given[1]: The transaction ID counter is a 6-digit unsigned number that starts at 0 when the program begins.
fields=['WS-TRANID-SUFFIX'] literals=['0']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   169            05 WS-TOTAL-INT              PIC S9(09)V99.
   170            05 WS-FIRST-TIME             PIC X(01) VALUE 'Y'.
   171        01 WS-COUNTERS.
   172            05 WS-RECORD-COUNT           PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
>> 173            05 WS-TRANID-SUFFIX          PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
   174 
   175        LINKAGE SECTION.
   176        01  EXTERNAL-PARMS.
   177            05  PARM-LENGTH         PIC S9(04) COMP.

### given[2]: The run date parameter is 10 characters long and is passed to the program.
fields=['PARM-DATE'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   174 
   175        LINKAGE SECTION.
   176        01  EXTERNAL-PARMS.
   177            05  PARM-LENGTH         PIC S9(04) COMP.
>> 178            05  PARM-DATE           PIC X(10).
   179       *****************************************************************
   180        PROCEDURE DIVISION USING EXTERNAL-PARMS.
   181            DISPLAY 'START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT04C'.
   182            PERFORM 0000-TCATBALF-OPEN.

### when[0]: The interest transaction is built and written to the transaction file.
fields=['FD-TRANFILE-REC', 'TRAN-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   469 
   470            EXIT.
   471 
   472       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
>> 473        1300-B-WRITE-TX.
>> 474            ADD 1 TO WS-TRANID-SUFFIX
>> 475 
>> 476            STRING PARM-DATE,
>> 477                   WS-TRANID-SUFFIX
>> 478              DELIMITED BY SIZE
>> 479              INTO TRAN-ID
>> 480            END-STRING.
>> 481 
>> 482            MOVE '01'                 TO TRAN-TYPE-CD
>> 483            MOVE '05'                 TO TRAN-CAT-CD
>> 484            MOVE 'System'             TO TRAN-SOURCE
>> 485            STRING 'Int. for a/c ' ,
>> 486                   ACCT-ID
>> 487                   DELIMITED BY SIZE
>> 488             INTO TRAN-DESC
>> 489            END-STRING
>> 490            MOVE WS-MONTHLY-INT       TO TRAN-AMT
>> 491            MOVE 0                    TO TRAN-MERCHANT-ID
>> 492            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME
>> 493            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-CITY
>> 494            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP
>> 495            MOVE XREF-CARD-NUM        TO TRAN-CARD-NUM
>> 496            PERFORM Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP
>> 497            MOVE DB2-FORMAT-TS        TO TRAN-ORIG-TS
>> 498            MOVE DB2-FORMAT-TS        TO TRAN-PROC-TS
>> 499 
>> 500            WRITE FD-TRANFILE-REC FROM TRAN-RECORD
   501            IF  TRANFILE-STATUS   = '00'
   502                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   503            ELSE
   504                MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT

### then[0]: The counter is increased by 1. TRAN-ID (16 characters) is the 10-character run date followed by the 6-digit, zero-padded counter.
fields=['WS-TRANID-SUFFIX', 'PARM-DATE', 'TRAN-ID'] literals=['1']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   470            EXIT.
   471 
   472       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   473        1300-B-WRITE-TX.
>> 474            ADD 1 TO WS-TRANID-SUFFIX
>> 475 
>> 476            STRING PARM-DATE,
>> 477                   WS-TRANID-SUFFIX
>> 478              DELIMITED BY SIZE
>> 479              INTO TRAN-ID
>> 480            END-STRING.
   481 
   482            MOVE '01'                 TO TRAN-TYPE-CD
   483            MOVE '05'                 TO TRAN-CAT-CD
   484            MOVE 'System'             TO TRAN-SOURCE

### then[1]: TRAN-TYPE-CD is set to '01'.
fields=['TRAN-TYPE-CD'] literals=['01']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   478              DELIMITED BY SIZE
   479              INTO TRAN-ID
   480            END-STRING.
   481 
>> 482            MOVE '01'                 TO TRAN-TYPE-CD
   483            MOVE '05'                 TO TRAN-CAT-CD
   484            MOVE 'System'             TO TRAN-SOURCE
   485            STRING 'Int. for a/c ' ,
   486                   ACCT-ID

### then[2]: TRAN-CAT-CD is set from the literal '05'.
fields=['TRAN-CAT-CD'] literals=['05']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   479              INTO TRAN-ID
   480            END-STRING.
   481 
   482            MOVE '01'                 TO TRAN-TYPE-CD
>> 483            MOVE '05'                 TO TRAN-CAT-CD
   484            MOVE 'System'             TO TRAN-SOURCE
   485            STRING 'Int. for a/c ' ,
   486                   ACCT-ID
   487                   DELIMITED BY SIZE

### then[3]: TRAN-CAT-CD is a 4-digit unsigned numeric field, so the stored category code is 0005.
fields=['TRAN-CAT-CD'] literals=[]
CVTRA05Y.cpy:
     3       *****************************************************************
     4        01  TRAN-RECORD.
     5            05  TRAN-ID                                 PIC X(16).
     6            05  TRAN-TYPE-CD                            PIC X(02).
>>   7            05  TRAN-CAT-CD                             PIC 9(04).
     8            05  TRAN-SOURCE                             PIC X(10).
     9            05  TRAN-DESC                               PIC X(100).
    10            05  TRAN-AMT                                PIC S9(09)V99.
    11            05  TRAN-MERCHANT-ID                        PIC 9(09).

### then[4]: TRAN-SOURCE is set to 'System'.
fields=['TRAN-SOURCE'] literals=['System']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   480            END-STRING.
   481 
   482            MOVE '01'                 TO TRAN-TYPE-CD
   483            MOVE '05'                 TO TRAN-CAT-CD
>> 484            MOVE 'System'             TO TRAN-SOURCE
   485            STRING 'Int. for a/c ' ,
   486                   ACCT-ID
   487                   DELIMITED BY SIZE
   488             INTO TRAN-DESC

### then[5]: TRAN-SOURCE is a 10-character field, so 'System' is followed by 4 trailing spaces.
fields=['TRAN-SOURCE'] literals=[]
CVTRA05Y.cpy:
     4        01  TRAN-RECORD.
     5            05  TRAN-ID                                 PIC X(16).
     6            05  TRAN-TYPE-CD                            PIC X(02).
     7            05  TRAN-CAT-CD                             PIC 9(04).
>>   8            05  TRAN-SOURCE                             PIC X(10).
     9            05  TRAN-DESC                               PIC X(100).
    10            05  TRAN-AMT                                PIC S9(09)V99.
    11            05  TRAN-MERCHANT-ID                        PIC 9(09).
    12            05  TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME                      PIC X(50).

### then[6]: TRAN-DESC receives 'Int. for a/c ' followed immediately by the account ID. STRING does not clear the rest of TRAN-DESC, so any characters after the account ID keep their previous contents.
fields=['ACCT-ID', 'TRAN-DESC'] literals=['Int. for a/c ']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   481 
   482            MOVE '01'                 TO TRAN-TYPE-CD
   483            MOVE '05'                 TO TRAN-CAT-CD
   484            MOVE 'System'             TO TRAN-SOURCE
>> 485            STRING 'Int. for a/c ' ,
>> 486                   ACCT-ID
>> 487                   DELIMITED BY SIZE
>> 488             INTO TRAN-DESC
>> 489            END-STRING
   490            MOVE WS-MONTHLY-INT       TO TRAN-AMT
   491            MOVE 0                    TO TRAN-MERCHANT-ID
   492            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME
   493            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-CITY

### then[7]: The account ID is an 11-digit unsigned number, so all 11 digits, including leading zeros, are copied into the description.
fields=['ACCT-ID'] literals=[]
CVACT01Y.cpy:
     1       *****************************************************************
     2       *    Data-structure for  account entity (RECLN 300)
     3       *****************************************************************
     4        01  ACCOUNT-RECORD.
>>   5            05  ACCT-ID                           PIC 9(11).
     6            05  ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS                PIC X(01).
     7            05  ACCT-CURR-BAL                     PIC S9(10)V99.
     8            05  ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT                 PIC S9(10)V99.
     9            05  ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT            PIC S9(10)V99.

### then[8]: TRAN-DESC is a 100-character field, so the 24 characters written by STRING fill only its first 24 positions.
fields=['TRAN-DESC'] literals=[]
CVTRA05Y.cpy:
     5            05  TRAN-ID                                 PIC X(16).
     6            05  TRAN-TYPE-CD                            PIC X(02).
     7            05  TRAN-CAT-CD                             PIC 9(04).
     8            05  TRAN-SOURCE                             PIC X(10).
>>   9            05  TRAN-DESC                               PIC X(100).
    10            05  TRAN-AMT                                PIC S9(09)V99.
    11            05  TRAN-MERCHANT-ID                        PIC 9(09).
    12            05  TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME                      PIC X(50).
    13            05  TRAN-MERCHANT-CITY                      PIC X(50).

### then[9]: TRAN-AMT is set to the monthly interest amount.
fields=['WS-MONTHLY-INT', 'TRAN-AMT'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   486                   ACCT-ID
   487                   DELIMITED BY SIZE
   488             INTO TRAN-DESC
   489            END-STRING
>> 490            MOVE WS-MONTHLY-INT       TO TRAN-AMT
   491            MOVE 0                    TO TRAN-MERCHANT-ID
   492            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME
   493            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-CITY
   494            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP

### then[10]: TRAN-MERCHANT-ID is set to zero. TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME, TRAN-MERCHANT-CITY and TRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP are set to spaces.
fields=['TRAN-MERCHANT-ID', 'TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME', 'TRAN-MERCHANT-CITY', 'TRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP'] literals=['0']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   487                   DELIMITED BY SIZE
   488             INTO TRAN-DESC
   489            END-STRING
   490            MOVE WS-MONTHLY-INT       TO TRAN-AMT
>> 491            MOVE 0                    TO TRAN-MERCHANT-ID
>> 492            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME
>> 493            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-CITY
>> 494            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP
   495            MOVE XREF-CARD-NUM        TO TRAN-CARD-NUM
   496            PERFORM Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP
   497            MOVE DB2-FORMAT-TS        TO TRAN-ORIG-TS
   498            MOVE DB2-FORMAT-TS        TO TRAN-PROC-TS

### then[11]: TRAN-CARD-NUM is set to the card number from the account's cross-reference record.
fields=['XREF-CARD-NUM', 'TRAN-CARD-NUM'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   491            MOVE 0                    TO TRAN-MERCHANT-ID
   492            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME
   493            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-CITY
   494            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP
>> 495            MOVE XREF-CARD-NUM        TO TRAN-CARD-NUM
   496            PERFORM Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP
   497            MOVE DB2-FORMAT-TS        TO TRAN-ORIG-TS
   498            MOVE DB2-FORMAT-TS        TO TRAN-PROC-TS
   499 

### then[12]: TRAN-ORIG-TS and TRAN-PROC-TS are both set to the same current timestamp.
fields=['DB2-FORMAT-TS', 'TRAN-ORIG-TS', 'TRAN-PROC-TS'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   492            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME
   493            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-CITY
   494            MOVE SPACES               TO TRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP
   495            MOVE XREF-CARD-NUM        TO TRAN-CARD-NUM
>> 496            PERFORM Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP
>> 497            MOVE DB2-FORMAT-TS        TO TRAN-ORIG-TS
>> 498            MOVE DB2-FORMAT-TS        TO TRAN-PROC-TS
   499 
   500            WRITE FD-TRANFILE-REC FROM TRAN-RECORD
   501            IF  TRANFILE-STATUS   = '00'
   502                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT

### then[13]: The timestamp is built from the system date and time as YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.hh0000, where hh is hundredths of a second and is followed by '0000'.
fields=['COBOL-TS', 'DB2-YYYY', 'DB2-MM', 'DB2-DD', 'DB2-HH', 'DB2-MIN', 'DB2-SS', 'DB2-MIL', 'DB2-REST', 'COB-MIL'] literals=['0000', '-', '.']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   610            END-IF
   611            EXIT.
   612 
   613        Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP.
>> 614            MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO COBOL-TS
>> 615            MOVE COB-YYYY TO DB2-YYYY
>> 616            MOVE COB-MM   TO DB2-MM
>> 617            MOVE COB-DD   TO DB2-DD
>> 618            MOVE COB-HH   TO DB2-HH
>> 619            MOVE COB-MIN  TO DB2-MIN
>> 620            MOVE COB-SS   TO DB2-SS
>> 621            MOVE COB-MIL  TO DB2-MIL
>> 622            MOVE '0000'   TO DB2-REST
>> 623            MOVE '-' TO DB2-STREEP-1 DB2-STREEP-2 DB2-STREEP-3
>> 624            MOVE '.' TO DB2-DOT-1 DB2-DOT-2 DB2-DOT-3
   625       *    DISPLAY 'DB2-TIMESTAMP = ' DB2-FORMAT-TS
   626            EXIT.
   627 
   628        9999-ABEND-PROGRAM.

### then[14]: The completed record is appended to the sequential transaction file. If the write fails (status other than '00'), the program displays 'ERROR WRITING TRANSACTION RECORD' and ends abnormally.
fields=['FD-TRANFILE-REC', 'TRAN-RECORD', 'TRANFILE-STATUS'] literals=['00', 'ERROR WRITING TRANSACTION RECORD']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   496            PERFORM Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP
   497            MOVE DB2-FORMAT-TS        TO TRAN-ORIG-TS
   498            MOVE DB2-FORMAT-TS        TO TRAN-PROC-TS
   499 
>> 500            WRITE FD-TRANFILE-REC FROM TRAN-RECORD
>> 501            IF  TRANFILE-STATUS   = '00'
>> 502                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
>> 503            ELSE
>> 504                MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT
>> 505            END-IF
>> 506 
>> 507            IF  APPL-AOK
>> 508                CONTINUE
>> 509            ELSE
>> 510                DISPLAY 'ERROR WRITING TRANSACTION RECORD'
>> 511                MOVE TRANFILE-STATUS   TO IO-STATUS
>> 512                PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
>> 513                PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
   514            END-IF
   515            EXIT.
   516 
   517       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
